location_exception_reason: Modular cottages are destination-driven hospitality products; geographic origin (hill stations, coastal resorts, farmhouse belts) is a genuine buyer decision factor for resort developers and eco-tourism operators selecting location-appropriate designs and climate-suited materials.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in cottage titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'A-Frame Cottage Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged — the product is still an A-frame cottage.
